params.name: limited
params.description:
Whether the phone information is limited.
If false, this returns a DeviceGraphUnlimited which contains extensive information about the telephone number and account.
If true this returns a DeviceGraphLimited which only lists the phone numbers.

params.name: macaddress
params.description: The mac address of the phone interface

items.docs: Use to search for a deviceGraph, which is defined as information about a specific physical phone interface, plus information about all of the phone numbers which ring that device.
